candidates.source_description:
V. Sathyabama Makes History in Tamil Nadu Assembly | First Woman to Preside | Rootcast


A historic moment in the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly** as **TVK MLA V. Sathyabama**, representing **Tiruppur North**, presided over an Assembly session as a temporary/Panel Speaker.

She became the **first woman to occupy the Speaker’s chair and moderate a session** in the history of the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly.
